visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows thick, pale yellow cheese sauce being poured slowly over a golden-brown baked potato and beef dish. High-contrast lighting emphasizes the glossy texture of the sauce. White text overlays appear at the top. (2) The camera transitions to a cross-section of the dish, revealing a dark, seasoned ground beef layer sandwiched between two thick layers of golden-brown shredded potatoes. (3) A pair of hands wearing clear plastic gloves holds a glass bowl filled with uniform, small white potato cubes on a bright, minimalist background. (4) The scene shifts to a top-down view on a wooden surface where yellow egg yolks, white diced onions, and dried green herbs are added sequentially into the potato bowl. (5) Gloved hands are shown vigorously mixing the potato and egg mixture, ensuring an even coat across all pieces. (6) In a new glass bowl, ground pinkish-red beef is mixed with chopped brown mushrooms, white onions, and minced garlic, followed by sprinkles of white sugar and black pepper. (7) A circular silver baking mold lined with white parchment paper is placed on the table, and the potato mixture is pressed firmly into the bottom. (8) The seasoned beef mixture is added as a middle layer and smoothed out before the remaining potato mixture is pressed on top to form a tight seal. (9) The mold is slid into a black electric oven; a glowing orange heating element is visible as the door is closed. Text overlays indicate temperature and time. (10) In a black non-stick pan, shredded yellow and white cheese is combined with fresh white milk over a blue gas flame. (11) A wire whisk is used to stir the mixture until it becomes a smooth, velvety sauce. (12) The final dish is presented on a wooden board, and the warm cheese sauce is poured generously over the top, flowing down the sides in slow motion.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 牛肉馬鈴薯起司醬. [Logo]: wecook123. (2) [Subtitle]: 市售都買得到的炸薯條. (3) [Subtitle]: 用切丁的方式. (4) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥 雞蛋2顆. (5) [Subtitle]: 乾燥百里香 5g 糖 黑胡椒粉 2g. (6) [Subtitle]: 鹽 2g. (7) [Subtitle]: 拌均勻就可以了. (8) [Subtitle]: 牛絞肉 150g 蘑菇碎 50g. (9) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥碎 40g 蒜碎. (10) [Subtitle]: 糖 適量 鹽巴 黑胡椒 適量. (11) [Subtitle]: 一樣給它拌一起. (12) [Subtitle]: 選用的模具 大概是6吋的大小. (13) [Subtitle]: 拌好的薯丁 大概放1/3滿. (14) [Subtitle]: 稍微要壓一下 讓它有點紮實感. (15) [Subtitle]: 下牛絞肉 一樣旁邊鋪平. (16) [Subtitle]: 剩下的薯丁 一樣給它壓緊它. (17) [Subtitle]: 烤箱180℃ 烤40~45分鐘. (18) [Subtitle]: 做這道的靈魂醬 雙色起司 60g. (19) [Subtitle]: 鮮奶 60g. (20) [Subtitle]: 這時候可以開火了 開始慢慢融化. (21) [Subtitle]: 就可以關火了. (22) [Subtitle]: 用它剩下的餘溫下去攪拌. (23) [Subtitle]: 鋪在上面 就完成囉. (24) [Slogan]: 完整影片請收看料理123.

(2) Soft thudding sounds of potatoes and eggs hitting a glass bowl are heard under the narration. (3) A rhythmic metallic clicking sound occurs as the gas stove is ignited, followed by the soft, continuous scratching/swishing sound of a wire whisk moving through thick liquid. (4) A metallic clink and a muffled sliding sound mark the baking mold entering the oven. (5) A final liquid pouring sound is heard as the sauce is served, accompanied by a slightly more enthusiastic and higher-pitched closing remark from the narrator.
